source_type: unfiltered archived training-pod log API export

artifacts.scope: All messages returned for the selected training pod; payload redaction preserves every record position. Not a complete external service/worker archive.
All messages returned for the selected training pod; payload redaction preserves every record position. Not a complete external service/worker archive.

policy.record_filtering: none; every source message has an output record
policy.payloads: Private prompt, sample, scorer, credential and launch context are replaced with explicit redaction markers. Only standard numeric training metrics and structural traceback/progress events are published.
policy.metrics: Published numeric values are extracted from original dictionaries without alteration; private scorer keys are omitted.
limitations: Training pods only; external Ray actor/service file logs and tracker binaries were not returned by this API.
Redacted records are evidence of log coverage, not reconstructed training events.
Historical full-size execution and new reduced-size validation runs are separate artifacts.
